scope: Ordinary posts are independent and unconverted — T-502, T-503, T-504, T-506, T-508, T-512

cases.claim: A profile with no intro post and an undecorated room can publish a photo post.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::publishing_works_with_a_default_room_and_no_intro_post — the fixture asserts zero intro_posts rows, inserts a default room, publishes, and asserts the room row is byte-identical afterwards and there is still no intro post.

frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/ProfileMediaComposer.test.tsx::publishes_a_photo_post_with_a_default_room_and_no_intro_post — the request sequence is exactly the four profile-post operations; no intro-post or room operation is ever sent.

cases.claim: The published image bytes are the normalized photograph, not a pixel conversion.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::the_stored_bytes_are_the_normalized_photograph_not_a_conversion — the stored sanitized bytes decode to the source pixels exactly, at the source dimensions (120 x 90, not a poster's 128 px cap).

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::the_stored_bytes_are_the_normalized_photograph_not_a_conversion — the same assertion at the upload layer, plus no EXIF/ICC/text chunk survives the sanitizer.

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::the_command_module_contains_no_pixel_conversion — the post command module contains no image code at all (no posterize/palette/quantize/resize/sanitize call).

cases.claim: No poster record is created as a side effect.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::no_poster_record_is_created_as_a_side_effect — no ROOM_POSTER asset exists for the author afterwards, no room row is created, and the media purpose is still PROFILE_POST.

cases.claim: The photo post appears in the profile gallery for an authorized visitor.
Deleting the photo post leaves the room and intro posts intact.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_post_lifecycle.rs::deleting_a_profile_post_leaves_the_room_avatar_intro_and_favorites_untouched — a full snapshot (room revision/layout/visibility, avatar revision/config, every intro post row, every intro attachment, the like count) is compared before and after.

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_post_lifecycle.rs::deleting_a_profile_post_keeps_its_media_available_to_other_posts — the media file survives a delete while another post still references it.

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_post_lifecycle.rs::a_profile_post_delete_statement_names_no_neighbour_table — the command's SQL never names profile_rooms, profile_avatars, intro_posts, intro_attachments, intro_likes or profile_favorites.

hard_constraints.constraint: A post with an INTRO_POST media id is REJECTED.
The stored bytes are the normalized photograph, NOT a pixel conversion.
Publishing works with a default room and no intro post.
A private post is absent from a visitor's list and 404 on direct read; the author sees it.
Deleting a profile post leaves room, avatar, intro posts, and favorites untouched.
A foreign media id is rejected without revealing whether it exists.
hard_constraints.evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::a_foreign_media_id_is_rejected_without_revealing_whether_it_exists — the foreign and absent answers are compared for equality.

hard_constraints.constraint: Only JPEG/PNG/WebP; 10 MiB; 4096 px; 16M pixels. No GIF, no video.
A cancelled upload leaves no orphan.
hard_constraints.evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::a_cancelled_upload_leaves_no_orphan_once_the_window_passes and ::an_abandoned_upload_is_cleaned_after_the_orphan_window; frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::cancelling_before_finalize_never_publishes_and_never_creates_a_post and ::leaving_the_screen_mid_upload_cancels_cleanly. See v10-upload-failure.json for the client half.
